<!--
The Great Team Draw (revealjs only): a full slide that splits the class roster into
4 random teams, name by name, when you advance.

Usage: include _extensions/paytonej/ucinci/resources/partials/team-draw-4.qmd between two slides; it makes its own slide
(the shortcode is not written out here because Quarto expands it inside comments).
team-draw-2 ... team-draw-6 differ only in the number of teams. Use one per deck.
Needs the Jupyter engine with pandas (and openpyxl for .xlsx).
-->

## {background-color="#000000" background-gradient="linear-gradient(to bottom, #404040, #000000)"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
import pandas as pd
import json

# Roster: a spreadsheet or CSV with a "First Name" column. Set roster_file in an
# earlier code cell to use another file; without one, sample names are drawn.
try:
    _rf = globals().get("roster_file", "Roster.xlsx")
    df = pd.read_csv(_rf) if str(_rf).lower().endswith(".csv") else pd.read_excel(_rf)
    col = "First Name" if "First Name" in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    names = df[col].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
    names = [n for n in names if n]
except Exception:
    # Fallback if there is no roster file
    names = ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana", "Eve", "Frank",
             "Grace", "Henry", "Isabel", "Jack", "Kate", "Liam"]

print(f'<script>const PARTICIPANTS = {json.dumps(names)}; const NUM_TEAMS = 4;</script>')
```

```{=html}
<style>
/* UC brand styling: Jost headings, Open Sans text, white text on black, UC colors

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════ MARKUP ═══ -->
<div class="draw-app">

  <div class="draw-title-bar">
    <div class="draw-main-title">The Great Team Draw</div>
    <p class="draw-subtitle" id="draw-subtitle">
      <span class="spinner-ring" id="spinner"></span>
      <span id="status-text">Loading…</span>
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="draw-body" id="draw-body"></div>
</div>

<!-- Invisible RevealJS fragment — advance button triggers the draw -->
<span class="fragment" id="draw-frag"></span>

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════ SCRIPT ═══ -->
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // UC colors for the teams (ucinci-brand.yaml), and the text color allowed on each:
  // UC red, Gettler gold, white, Steger silver, Calhoun maroon, Tangeman tan,
  // UC dark red, Main Street Mist.
  var PALETTE = ['#e00122','#d1b179','#ffffff','#a7a5aa','#890519','#eadbc1','#b8011c','#e0dfe3'];
  var TEXT_ON = ['#ffffff','#000000','#000000','#000000','#ffffff','#000000','#ffffff','#000000'];
  var drawn = false;

  /* ── Team formation: exactly NUM_TEAMS teams, sizes differ by at most 1 ── */
  function buildTeams(names, numTeams) {
    var shuffled = names.slice();
    shuffled.sort(function () { return Math.random() - 0.5; });
    var n = shuffled.length;
    numTeams = Math.max(1, Math.min(numTeams, n));
    var base = Math.floor(n / numTeams);
    var remainder = n % numTeams;
    var teams = [];
    var idx = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < numTeams; i++) {
      var size = base + (i < remainder ? 1 : 0);
      teams.push(shuffled.slice(idx, idx + size));
      idx += size;
    }
    return teams;
  }

  /* ── Bootstrap ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function init() {
    if (typeof Reveal === 'undefined') { setTimeout(init, 60); return; }

    var status = document.getElementById('status-text');
    if (status && typeof PARTICIPANTS !== 'undefined') {
      status.textContent =
        PARTICIPANTS.length + ' participants — press → to draw ' + NUM_TEAMS + ' teams';
    }

    Reveal.on('fragmentshown', function (e) {
      if (e.fragment && e.fragment.id === 'draw-frag' && !drawn) {
        drawn = true;
        startDraw();
      }
    });

    Reveal.on('fragmenthidden', function (e) {
      if (e.fragment && e.fragment.id === 'draw-frag') {
        drawn = false;
        resetDraw();
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── Build (empty) team panels ───────────────────────────── */
  function renderPanels(numTeams) {
    var body = document.getElementById('draw-body');
    body.innerHTML = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < numTeams; i++) {
      var color = PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length];

      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'team-panel';
      panel.style.borderColor = color;

      var heading = document.createElement('div');
      heading.className = 'team-heading';
      heading.textContent = 'TEAM ' + (i + 1);
      heading.style.background = color;
      heading.style.color = TEXT_ON[i % TEXT_ON.length];
      panel.appendChild(heading);

      var list = document.createElement('div');
      list.className = 'name-list';
      list.id = 'team' + i + '-list';
      panel.appendChild(list);

      body.appendChild(panel);
    }
  }

  /* ── Main draw sequence ─────────────────────────────────── */
  function startDraw() {
    var status  = document.getElementById('status-text');
    var spinner = document.getElementById('spinner');
    spinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
    status.textContent = 'SHUFFLING…';

    var names = (typeof PARTICIPANTS !== 'undefined') ? PARTICIPANTS : [];
    var count = (typeof NUM_TEAMS !== 'undefined') ? NUM_TEAMS : 4;
    var teams = buildTeams(names, count);
    renderPanels(teams.length);

    var maxSize = teams.reduce(function (m, t) { return Math.max(m, t.length); }, 0);
    var order = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < maxSize; r++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < teams.length; j++) {
        if (r < teams[j].length) order.push({ team: j, name: teams[j][r] });
      }
    }

    var GAP   = 260;   // ms between successive name reveals
    var START = 1200;  // ms of "shuffling" before first name

    order.forEach(function (item, idx) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        addCard(item.team, item.name, PALETTE[item.team % PALETTE.length]);
      }, START + idx * GAP);
    });

    var finishAt = START + order.length * GAP + 350;
    setTimeout(function () {
      spinner.style.display = 'none';
      var sub = document.getElementById('draw-subtitle');
      sub.classList.add('done');
      status.textContent = 'Teams set!';
      fireConfetti();
    }, finishAt);
  }

  /* ── Add one name card to a team panel ───────────────────── */
  function addCard(teamIdx, name, color) {
    var list = document.getElementById('team' + teamIdx + '-list');
    if (!list) return;
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'name-card';
    card.style.borderLeftColor = color;
    card.textContent = name;
    list.appendChild(card);
    list.scrollTop = list.scrollHeight;
  }

  /* ── Reset for when user navigates back ─────────────────── */
  function resetDraw() {
    document.getElementById('draw-body').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('spinner').style.display = 'none';
    var sub = document.getElementById('draw-subtitle');
    sub.classList.remove('done');
    var status = document.getElementById('status-text');
    if (typeof PARTICIPANTS !== 'undefined') {
      status.textContent =
        PARTICIPANTS.length + ' participants — press → to draw ' + NUM_TEAMS + ' teams';
    }
  }

  /* ── Confetti burst ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  function fireConfetti() {
    var palette = ['#e00122','#ffffff','#d1b179','#a7a5aa','#eadbc1','#b8011c'];   // UC colors
    for (var i = 0; i < 110; i++) {
      (function (i) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          var el = document.createElement('div');
          el.className = 'confetti-bit';
          var size = Math.random() * 9 + 5;
          el.style.cssText = [
            'left:'             + (Math.random() * 100) + '%',
            'width:'            + size + 'px',
            'height:'           + size + 'px',
            'background:'       + palette[i % palette.length],
            'border-radius:'    + (Math.random() > .45 ? '50%' : '3px'),
            'animation-duration:'+ (Math.random() * 2 + 2.2) + 's',
            'animation-delay:'  + (Math.random() * .6) + 's'
          ].join(';');
          document.body.appendChild(el);
          setTimeout(function () {
            if (el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
          }, 5500);
        }, i * 22);
      })(i);
    }
  }

  /* ── Kick off ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }

}());
</script>
```
